name: Behind the Oaks Farm
tagline: Behind the Oaks Farm • South Central Texas Regenerative Meat & Eggs
description: Behind the Oaks Farm is an agritourism farm in 8522 Greaves Lane Schertz, TX, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
